current_surface_boundary.rule: Reuse evidence may constrain a future Facultad implementation, but must not materialize or promote a Facultad route, owner or identity.

capability_map.integration_seam: A future Facultad page should be hosted as a page inside the existing Universal Host and route human corrections/work through page-scoped Change Threads.
Use page_id/page_title scoped capture and execution calls rather than building a Facultad-only upload/research/work transport.

capability_map.compatibility_rule: backward-compatible fixes only inside v1; breaking changes publish v2 and migrate consumers explicitly
capability_map.integration_seam: Start a future Facultad study/library presentation layer from the versioned Study UI contract where applicable, while keeping Facultad information architecture and authority separate.
do_not_duplicate: generic study component CSS/JS already provided by Study UI v1
breaking changes inside the v1 contract

capability_map.integration_seam: Mine proven interaction/component patterns selectively; do not rename, clone or treat these pages as Facultad ancestry/identity without explicit authority evidence.
do_not_duplicate: whole-page forks based only on study/facultad semantic similarity
implicit migration of existing study consumers into Facultad

capability_map.integration_seam: If Facultad embeds class/material experiences, consume the PageKit host candidate behind its existing ownership/focus semantics rather than reimplementing a player/window host.

critical_rules: explicit IDs do not bypass privacy
superseded current truth excluded unless historical
capability_map.integration_seam: For a future library/search/context layer, reuse the foundry's authority/privacy/selection pipeline rather than making file presence equal knowledge participation.
do_not_duplicate: ad-hoc context ranking without authority/privacy inheritance
parallel note/context atom format unless a gap is demonstrated

capability_map.capability: Universal cognitive worker / page-thread execution substrate
capability_map.integration_seam: A future Facultad correction/work request should enter the existing page thread -> planner/workers -> local steward loop instead of embedding a second agent scheduler in page code.

prompt_os.decision: Do not invent or alias a Prompt OS owner. Reuse only exact prompt contracts if/when an authoritative artifact is resolved by a later lane.

context_os.decision: Treat Context Foundry v2 as candidate capability evidence, not as Served Facultad authority.

served: Universal Host V5 exact manifested bytes and its page-thread/capture/launcher capabilities
current: current catalog registration of existing study donor pages
shared capture source and current page-change-loop client contract
historical_or_non_authoritative: semantic study/facultad similarity is not lineage
retired Prometeo shell implementations are not Facultad UI donors by default
unresolved Prompt OS naming is not sufficient authority

anti_duplication_rules: Do not create a second global shell for Facultad; use Universal Host.
Do not create a Facultad-only notes/attachments/agent-result inbox before proving a gap in Change Threads/Capture.
Do not fork Study UI v1 for ordinary compatible fixes; respect its versioning contract.
Do not rebuild PageKit host/player lifecycle inside Facultad.
Do not equate file existence with usable study knowledge; use Context Foundry authority/privacy/selection rules if that candidate is adopted.
Do not treat study-system/study-hub as Facultad ancestry merely because their domain is study.
Do not materialize a Facultad route from this reuse map.

non_obvious_findings.finding: The strongest first reuse for Facultad is not a study component: the Served Universal Host already owns the one-message correction/work surface, capture, private attachment intake, unread/result feed and disposable agent launcher. A new Facultad shell or inbox would duplicate live infrastructure before the page itself is even authoritative.

shared/study/current.json provides a real versioned reusable Study UI contract with named consumers, while current catalog study pages are separate page identities. Reusing components does not imply merging those identities into Facultad.

PageKit Host v2 and Context Foundry v2 are tested candidates, so a future Facultad plan may stage them behind explicit gates but cannot treat them as Served dependencies or silently bake them into a Current route.

The queue mission names Prompt/Context OS, but this targeted pass did not prove a distinct current shared Prompt OS artifact. Recording that absence is safer than manufacturing an owner from similarly named prompt/context material.

deduplication.decision: No new opportunity emitted. Remaining obvious Facultad discovery/planning/risk/UX work and shared substrate work are already prepared or claimed.
